import zipfile, shutil, re

SRC = "sales_data.xlsx"
TMP = "sales_data_new.xlsx"

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    items = [(i, zin.read(i.filename)) for i in zin.infolist()]

sheet_xml = None
styles_xml = None
for info, data in items:
    if info.filename == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
        sheet_xml = data.decode("utf-8")
    elif info.filename == "xl/styles.xml":
        styles_xml = data.decode("utf-8")

assert sheet_xml is not None and styles_xml is not None

# ---- sheet1.xml edits ----
# 1) dimension
sheet_xml2 = sheet_xml.replace('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')
assert sheet_xml2 != sheet_xml
# 2) column width for H
sheet_xml2 = sheet_xml2.replace(
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>',
    1)
assert '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>' in sheet_xml2
# 3) header cell H1
sheet_xml2 = sheet_xml2.replace(
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>',
    1)
assert '<c r="H1" s="1"' in sheet_xml2
# 4) data rows 2..9: profit margin = Profit / Revenue = G/E
for r in range(2, 10):
    cell = f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    assert old in sheet_xml2, old
    sheet_xml2 = sheet_xml2.replace(old, old + cell, 1)
# 5) TOTAL row 10 (bold style index 4 = bold + percent)
old10 = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
assert old10 in sheet_xml2
sheet_xml2 = sheet_xml2.replace(old10, old10 + '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>', 1)

# ---- styles.xml edits ----
# 1) custom percent number format 0.0%
styles_xml2 = styles_xml.replace(
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>', 1)
assert 'numFmtId="164"' in styles_xml2
# 2) two new cellXfs: idx3 = percent (default font), idx4 = percent + bold
styles_xml2 = styles_xml2.replace(
    '<cellXfs count="3">',
    '<cellXfs count="5">', 1)
styles_xml2 = styles_xml2.replace(
    '</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '</cellXfs>', 1)
assert styles_xml2.count('<xf ') == 5

# validate XML parses
import xml.dom.minidom
xml.dom.minidom.parseString(sheet_xml2)
xml.dom.minidom.parseString(styles_xml2)

# write new zip preserving order
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for info, data in items:
        if info.filename == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
            data = sheet_xml2.encode("utf-8")
        elif info.filename == "xl/styles.xml":
            data = styles_xml2.encode("utf-8")
        zout.writestr(info, data)

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("OK: sales_data.xlsx updated")
